test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

She was completely **__baffled__** by his strange behaviour.
solution: The correct answer is **"confused."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** "baffled" **means confused or puzzled. (भ्रमित, उलझा हुआ) • **Example**: *The instructions were so complicated that I was completely **baffled**__.* • Synonyms of **'baffled' **include confused, bewildered, perplexed, and mystified. • **"Confused"** means not able to think clearly. (स्‍पष्‍ट रूप से सोच-विचार करने में असमर्थ; चकराया या उलझा हुआ, भ्रमित) __ • **Example**: *She was completely **confused**__ by the instructions for assembling the furniture.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (unfazed)** means not disturbed or affected by something. (बुरी या अनपेक्षित घटनाओं से अविचलित; निर्भीक; शांत) • **Option 3 (relieved) **means feeling happy or reassured because something unpleasant has stopped or has not happened. (ख़ुशी या आश्वस्त महसूस करना क्योंकि कुछ अप्रिय रुक गया है या नहीं हुआ है) • **Option 4 (angered)** means made someone feel angry or annoyed. (किसी को गुस्सा या झुंझलाहट महसूस कराना) 45:Tf03, The correct answer is **"Young minds are influenced by the speech of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam."**
